items.text: I'm thinking of trying out a new coffee recipe, but I'm not sure what type of coffee beans would pair well with citrus notes. Can you recommend some options? By the way, I've been experimenting with my French press and I've found that 1 tablespoon of coffee for every 6 ounces of water is the perfect ratio for me.
